completeLayer: Opening city, compact visual keys, and seven open readings. The headline alone is orientation.
scope: Physical package ownership versus concern owner and changed text, across all 26 PRs.

readings.portable: Reusable mechanisms move to core; language and host work stay with their owners.
readings.leaf: CLI owns environment resolution; daemon contracts/policy acquire a leaf package before mechanism relocation.
readings.host: Injected executor protects dependency direction; renderer receives formatting while CLI retains writes.
readings.split: Several new module owners appear inside the same CLI district before package cutover.
readings.stage: Package mechanisms and Node-free facade coexist with the frozen 38-file CLI graph and its active road.
readings.cutover: Invocation crosses to DaemonClient; frozen paths disappear, host tests remain, inspector and compiler checks enforce the boundary.
readings.tests: 37 test moves; generic worker fixture; timing observations removed without a specific located rationale; direct host version assertion replaces a worker-level observation.
